payload.title: The Lo-Fi Lodge
payload.paragraph_text: The Lo-Fi Lodge is a subscription based album by Mike Doughty. Fans could sign up in Spring 2012 to receive one song per week for the 32 weeks. The songs included acoustic versions of previously released material, demos and alternate versions of songs, as well as songs that have never been released in any fashion. Doughty also mentioned that the songs from the Evenhand soundtrack will finally be released through this album.

fact.subject: The Lo-Fi Lodge
fact.object: acoustic versions of previously released material

fact.subject: Mike Doughty
fact.object: songs from the Evenhand soundtrack will finally be released through The Lo-Fi Lodge
